overview_description.description:
Circle is a financial technology company that develops and manages digital currencies and blockchain-based financial infrastructure. It issues USD Coin (USDC) and Euro Coin (EURC), both fully backed stablecoins designed for global payments and digital transactions. 

Circle's platform supports businesses in integrating stablecoins into their operations, including cross-border payments and financial applications.

product.name: USDC
product.description: A regulated, fully reserved digital dollar designed for payments, settlement, trading, and programmable financial applications across supported blockchains.

product.name: Circle Mint
product.description: An institutional service for minting, redeeming, reserving, and managing USDC and accessing related fiat payment and liquidity capabilities.

product.name: Circle Payments Network
product.description: A network and integration layer that connects participating financial institutions for stablecoin-powered global payments and near-instant settlement.

product.name: EURC
product.description: A regulated, fully reserved digital euro designed for payments, settlement, treasury management, and programmable financial applications.

product.name: Circle Wallets
product.description: Developer-controlled and programmable wallet infrastructure for embedding digital-asset storage, payments, signing, and blockchain transactions into applications.

product.name: Circle Agent Stack
product.description: An infrastructure suite for building AI agents that hold assets, discover services, and execute programmable USDC transactions under defined spending policies.
